goal: Stop requiring bitcoinkernel consumers to parse formatted log strings to get metadata
Decouple kernel logging from node-specific logging internals to simplify the library boundary
agreement: Strong support for rationalizing the kernel logging interface (ryanofsky, w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: using singletons introduces viral coupling across kernel components (purpleKarrot)
Resolved objections around lifetime bugs, deadlocks, and argument side-effects (ajtowns, w0xlt)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it decouples node logging internals from the kernel library and unblocks follow-up kernel work
Consumers of the kernel library get direct access to log metadata instead of parsing formatted strings

categories.name: tests
why: Unranked because test updates only adapt existing kernel tests and suppressions to the interface change
Does not improve general test harness infrastructure or testing capabilities
